name: Optical character recognition (OCR)
short_description: Technology that reads the characters visible in an image or document and turns them into machine-readable text, without by itself knowing what that text means.

evidence.quote: OCR means optical character recognition. Put simply, it reads the characters it can see in an image or document.
Just take a photo of that, do an optical character recognition run
Optical character recognition, or OCR, for scanned PDFs, so text and images become searchable.
optical character recognition transforms images of text into machine readable text
